Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Female with surgically-confirmed endometriosis, determined at laparoscopy performed within 3y prior to study baseline
  -  Age 15 years to 40 years
  -  Current use ≥ 2 months duration of hormonal therapy such as combined oral contraceptives, [OR]  norethindrone acetate, [OR]  or levonorgestrel intrauterine device
  -  Current pelvic pain (score ≥ 3 on Visual Analog Scale, where 0 represents absence of pain and 10 indicates unbearable pain) present for ≥ 14 days/month over the 2 months prior to study enrollment
  -  Willingness to comply with visit schedule and protocol
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Pre-menarche  [OR] or post-menopause
  -  Contraindications to cabergoline (e

, cardiac valve disorder; pulmonary, [OR]  pericardial, [OR]  retroperitoneal fibrotic disorder; hypersensitivity to ergot derivatives; uncontrolled hypertension)

  -  Pregnant, [OR]  breastfeeding, [OR]  or planning to become pregnant in the next 6 months
  -  Impaired liver function (ALT > 2x normal) or liver disease
  -  Breast cancer, current  [OR] or previous
